At the bottom of the thundering stream, the spring waves are tossed, and the ice pearls hit the white dragon. Shizeng." Inscribed with the seal of "Shi Zeng". The painting shows a high cliff and a pine pavilion with thick and broad brushwork.　　From the author's self-title, it can be seen that this book was made in the year of the ninth year of the Republic of China (1912). This is an early painting of Chen Shizeng. From the viewpoint of the painting method, it has not yet formed a personal appearance, mainly imitating various artists, such as Jin Nong's plum blossoms, Luo Ren's bamboo, Ni Zan's thirsty brush, and so on. The brushwork and ink are loose and casual, reflecting the diversity of the artist's attempts when he was in the stage of exploring his techniques.
